Definition: a prolonged form of G3415 (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to remind, i.e. (middle voice) to recall to mind:--be mindful, remember.
BiblicalUsage: The word is to remember, and it carries both the sting and the comfort of memory. Peter remembered the word of Jesus and went out and wept, the angels told the women to remember what He had said in Galilee, and God promises that their sins and iniquities will He remember no more.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe memory is a gift God uses both ways: it convicts the sinner who forgot, and it frees the forgiven, because God Himself chooses to forget.
